references.title: Sennheiser Momentum 5 Wireless Bluetooth Headphones
references.text: The Sennheiser Momentum 5 is a pair of wireless over-ear noise-cancelling headphones with Bluetooth connectivity and a battery runtime of up to 57 hours. Designed for listening to music, films, and gaming, they combine active noise cancellation with a transparency mode. The Sennheiser Momentum 5 Wireless Noise-Cancelling Headphones offer up to 57 hours of playback with active noise cancellation enabled, utilizing hybrid adaptive noise cancellation with eight digital microphones. They feature a 42 mm high-fidelity driver inspired by the HD 600 and support aptX Lossless, aptX Adaptive, and AAC Bluetooth codecs. The headphones include Dolby Atmos Spatial Audio for a three-dimensional soundstage, and their beamforming microphones with voice recognition are designed for clear calls. Touch controls are included for easy operation, and the battery is replaceable for long-term use. The headphones come with a case, a cable, and a manual. Hybrid adaptive noise cancellation uses eight digital microphones to reduce distractions and is reported to be up to three times stronger in the midrange than the Momentum 4 Wireless. Touch controls allow for direct operation of the headphones. The transparency mode lets outside sound in naturally without interrupting the listening experience, while beamforming microphones with voice recognition ensure clear calls.
